# Recipe: Organize Drive Folder

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws recipe: create a Google Drive folder structure (project folder + sub-folders) and move existing files into the right locations via addParents/removeParents, then verify the structure with a folder listing. Requires the gws-drive utility skill plus the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it moves real files — confirm the target structure before the move step; shared-drive semantics differ from My Drive; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
